# Code of Conduct

## Our standard

This project welcomes people who participate in good faith. Be respectful,
specific, and constructive. Critique ideas and evidence rather than people.
Do not harass, threaten, demean, discriminate against, or deliberately disrupt
other contributors.

## Curatorial disagreements

An entry is not accepted or rejected based on popularity alone. Maintainers may
ask for clearer evidence of IINA relevance, working installation instructions,
licensing, maintenance status, or security posture. A declined submission is
not a judgment on its author.

## Enforcement

Report unacceptable behavior privately to `wyattowalsh@gmail.com`. Maintainers
may edit or remove content, close discussions, temporarily restrict
participation, or permanently ban participants when necessary to protect the
community. Reports will be reviewed as confidentially as practical.
